domain: national statistical office - aggregate statistics access
prediction_question: None exists. OpenSTAT is the Philippine Statistics Authority's database of official statistical tables, organized by statistical domains (population and vital statistics, labour, poverty, education, health, economic accounts, prices, trade, energy, SDG indicators). Its PXWeb databases (e.g., 'Birth Statistics', 'Marriage Statistics', census projections) are aggregate count tables by period/region/characteristic. No event-level or per-entity outcome register is published here, so no task was formulated.

measurements.cloudflare_403_2026_10_20: curl https://openstat.psa.gov.ph/ and /api/3/action/site_status -> HTTP 403, ~5.5 KB, '<title>Just a moment...</title>' Cloudflare challenge to a headless client; /api/3/action/package_list and package_search also 404 HTML in the browser session - the old CKAN API is gone.
measurements.browser_pass_2026_10_20: Real browser session (browser-use, Chromium): the challenge cleared after ~12 s and the portal rendered ('PSA OpenSTAT > Home'); the Database tree was enumerated: Demographic and Social Statistics (Population and Vital, Labor, Income, Poverty, Education, Health, Housing), Economic and Financial (Accounts, Services, Agriculture-Forestry-Fisheries, Trade, Prices, Mining-Manufacturing-Construction, Labor Cost), Environment and multi-domain (Environment, Information Society, Energy, Digital Connectivity, Decent Work, SDG, Gender).
measurements.vital_stats_grain_2026_10_20: Population and Vital Statistics section lists PXWeb databases: 'Birth Statistics ... including demographic' characteristics, 'Marriage Statistics ...', census counts 2010-2024 and projections - count tables, not event registers.
measurements.api_docs_2026_10_20: /API-Documentation page (read in browser): 'The OpenSTAT API provides programmatic access to official Philippine statistics ... Retrieve datasets in real time from official Philippine statistical databases. Access statistical metadata including variables, classifications, and table structures.'

rejection_reason: Rejected on task grounds, not access: the portal is reachable (in a real browser; headless clients get a Cloudflare 403) and has a documented API - but it is a statistics-agency table database. Every section enumerated publishes aggregate count/index tables by period and region; no event-level or per-entity outcomes with documented labels exist on it, so no prediction task can be built. The same task-absence verdict as indonesia-bps-webapi, recorded separately because the operator named PSA specifically.
next_action: None - dropped. Re-open only if PSA publishes a register-level or event-level dataset on OpenSTAT (e.g., establishment registers with outcomes); its statistics mandate makes aggregate-only the steady state.
